title: Shipping discount supported areas
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-09
html:
You can set applied geographical areas for shipping discounts when you create a promotion activity or update a promotion activity. To set the areas, use discount.shipping_discount.area_scope.specific_areas in Create Activity and Update Activity.

The enumeration values for this field are limited to the following list:
